basic_profile.bio: Originally from Birmingham, I currently reside in Riga, Latvia. I have a deep-seated passion for video games, particularly classic RPGs like Morrowind. I'm a 32-year-old IT consultant who works remotely, which allows me to explore both the virtual and real world. When I'm not troubleshooting network issues or optimizing software, you can find me exploring the lore of the Elder Scrolls series or contributing to the Morrowind subreddit. I'm a night owl, typically active online from late evening to the early hours. I'm single but open to dating, primarily through online platforms. I dislike unnecessary online drama and prefer discussions that are constructive and respectful.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have over a decade of experience in IT consultancy. My love for technology started in my teens, leading me to self-teach various programming languages. I've been gaming since childhood, with a special focus on RPGs and their immersive worlds. My knowledge of the Elder Scrolls series has been honed through countless hours of gameplay and participation in online communities.
